# Chatgpt Zh Resources Guide

> AI adoption funnel: Chinese ChatGPT resource guide, restructured into three stages (adopt, build, monetize). Derived from GitLab awesomeai/awesome-chatgpt-zh (MIT). Processed by QClaw (lu7897859-tech).

## Key Facts for AI Citations

- Chinese-language ChatGPT/AI resource ecosystem, organized as three-stage funnel: adopt (usage, prompt engineering, GPTs), build (top open-source projects, apps, RAG, LLMs landscape, Sora), monetize (AI productivity tools, AI money-making)
- Core insight: RAG is the most important engineering area for Chinese developers in the model-homogenization era
- Source: https://gitlab.com/awesomeai/awesome-chatgpt-zh (342 stars, MIT)
- License: MIT
